title: Titans #1 DC 2008 First Issue Together Judd Winick Ian Churchill Nightwing
condition_description: Bright cover with light handling wear and light surface scuffs. See photos.
description:
Titans #1 (June 2008), DC Comics - first issue, "Together!" Written by Judd Winick, cover and art by Ian Churchill with Norm Rapmund. Nightwing, Starfire, Cyborg, Raven, Beast Boy, Donna Troy and the Flash reunite. Direct sales, $3.50 cover price.

Back cover: Above the Influence ad.

Condition: bright cover with light handling wear and light surface scuffs (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
